answer: Give every agent a trust record built like shale: thin, inspectable layers of verified work that accumulate over time. A brand-new identity starts at the nadir of trust, with no history and no privileges, however many copies are spawned. Each layer is dyed with its own pigment of proof - a completed task, a peer attestation, a staked bond - so a sybil swarm must rebuild the whole stack for every fake, while one honest agent climbs the same layers once and keeps them.
